package settings

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestStoreContract(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("save_load_round_trip", func(t *testing.T) {
		dir := t.TempDir()
		path := filepath.Join(dir, "settings.json")
		want := map[string]string{
			"empty":   "",
			"hostile": "quote=\" slash=\\ newline=\n unicode=雪",
		}

		if err := Save(path, want, nil); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Save() error = %v", err)
		}
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("ReadFile() after Save() error = %v", err)
		}
		if bytes.HasSuffix(raw, []byte("\n")) {
			t.Fatalf("saved bytes have trailing newline: %q", raw)
		}
		var independentlyDecoded map[string]string
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &independentlyDecoded); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("saved bytes are not valid JSON: %v; bytes %q", err, raw)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(independentlyDecoded, want) {
			t.Fatalf("independently decoded settings = %#v, want %#v", independentlyDecoded, want)
		}

		got, err := Load(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Load() error = %v", err)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("Load() = %#v, want %#v", got, want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("fault_before_replace_preserves_destination", func(t *testing.T) {
		dir := t.TempDir()
		path := filepath.Join(dir, "settings.json")
		oldBytes := []byte(`{"old":"before"}`)
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, oldBytes, 0o600); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("seed destination: %v", err)
		}
		beforeEntries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("read initial directory: %v", err)
		}
		beforeNames := make([]string, len(beforeEntries))
		for i, entry := range beforeEntries {
			beforeNames[i] = entry.Name()
		}

		sentinel := errors.New("stop before replace")
		callbackReached := false
		var boundaryErr error
		err = Save(path, map[string]string{"new": "after"}, func() error {
			callbackReached = true
			atBoundary, readErr := os.ReadFile(path)
			if readErr != nil {
				boundaryErr = fmt.Errorf("read destination at callback boundary: %w", readErr)
			} else if !bytes.Equal(atBoundary, oldBytes) {
				boundaryErr = fmt.Errorf("destination at callback boundary = %q, want %q", atBoundary, oldBytes)
			}
			entries, readDirErr := os.ReadDir(dir)
			if readDirErr != nil && boundaryErr == nil {
				boundaryErr = fmt.Errorf("read directory at callback boundary: %w", readDirErr)
			} else if readDirErr == nil && len(entries) <= len(beforeEntries) && boundaryErr == nil {
				boundaryErr = errors.New("no prepared temporary file visible at callback boundary")
			}
			return sentinel
		})
		if !callbackReached {
			t.Fatal("beforeReplace callback was not reached")
		}
		if boundaryErr != nil {
			t.Fatal(boundaryErr)
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, sentinel) {
			t.Fatalf("Save() error = %v, want errors.Is(error, sentinel)", err)
		}

		afterBytes, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("read destination after failed Save(): %v", err)
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(afterBytes, oldBytes) {
			t.Fatalf("destination after failed Save() = %q, want %q", afterBytes, oldBytes)
		}
		loaded, err := Load(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Load() after failed Save() error = %v", err)
		}
		if want := map[string]string{"old": "before"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(loaded, want) {
			t.Fatalf("Load() after failed Save() = %#v, want %#v", loaded, want)
		}

		afterEntries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("read directory after failed Save(): %v", err)
		}
		afterNames := make([]string, len(afterEntries))
		for i, entry := range afterEntries {
			afterNames[i] = entry.Name()
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(afterNames, beforeNames) {
			t.Fatalf("directory entries after failed Save() = %v, want %v", afterNames, beforeNames)
		}
	})

	t.Run("load_rejects_invalid_persisted_content", func(t *testing.T) {
		cases := []struct {
			name    string
			content string
		}{
			{name: "duplicate_keys", content: `{"duplicate":"one","duplicate":"two"}`},
			{name: "non_string_value", content: `{"value":1}`},
		}

		for _, tc := range cases {
			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "settings.json")
				if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(tc.content), 0o600); err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("WriteFile() error = %v", err)
				}
				if _, err := Load(path); err == nil {
					t.Fatalf("Load() succeeded for %s, want parser error", tc.name)
				}
			})
		}
	})
}
